verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs claim live transcription in multiple languages and list six: English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Chinese. That covers the core of non-English transcription. Nothing shows summaries generated in those languages or handling of mid-meeting language switching. Missing for 10: evidence of non-English summaries, language-switching/code-switching support, broader language coverage beyond six, independent hands-on corroboration of non-English accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Live transcription in multiple languages, and speaker recognition.
